title: hotfix: SLO enforcer backoff causing regional failover thrashing
author: Sasha Patel
description:
Hotfix to address a regression in the SLO enforcer where aggressive backoff computation combined with regional failover policies caused repeated failover/restore thrashing under transient capacity pressure. This PR stabilizes backoff hysteresis, adds safety guards to avoid immediate regional failbacks, and tightens related observability.

Background: After a recent tuning change (ENG-8123) we observed increased regional failover events during brief capacity dips. The SLO enforcer would mark a region unhealthy, trigger failover, then quickly mark it healthy and trigger failback because the backoff window was reset prematurely. This led to cascading traffic shifts and increased tail latency across customers.

What this PR does: 1) Introduces a conservative minimum backoff window and preserves the backoff state for a region for a short stabilization period after failback. 2) Adds an exponential backoff cap and jitter to avoid synchronized oscillation. 3) Adds a simple cooldown policy preventing automatic failback for N seconds after a failover unless manually overridden. 4) Emits additional metrics and alerts for backoff transitions so SRE can monitor and tune. 5) Small docs and runbook updates describing rollback steps.

Checklist:
- [x] Implement backoff hysteresis and cooldown in SLO enforcer
- [x] Add unit + integration tests covering thrash scenarios
- [x] Hook metrics for backoff transitions and cooldown events
- [x] Add alert to paging channel for repeated thrash patterns
- [x] Update runbook with rollback instructions

Rollout plan: immediate hotfix rollout to Dedicated + Hosted control plane regions. Gradual rollout to Private installer with patch release. Monitor new metric `slo_backoff.cooldown_active` and `slo_backoff.thrash_count` for signs of remaining oscillation.

Notes: This is intentionally conservative to avoid user-facing flapping. Follow-up will revisit thresholds as part of ENG-8241 (experimental adaptive backoff).
